core.title: Steel No-Mortise Butt Hinge With Finial, Acorn AJ5BQ

text.description_html:
Acorn AJ5BQ, Semi Concealed Cabinet Hinge With Finial

This is a no-mortise cabinet hinge. It includes the decorative finial at the top and bottom of the pin. The inside portion of the hinge is mounted flush, as is the outside portion. This eliminates the need for mortising, making it easy to install with just a few screws. Another great feature of these hinges is that they can be mounted two ways depending on how you want the door to open and the configuration and style of the door you have (see illustration below).

Specifications of the Acorn AJ5BQ Steel No-Mortise Butt Hinge With Finial:

  • Finish: Smooth Iron
  • Height: 2-1/2"
  • Width: 1"
  • Overall Height: 3-9/16"
  • Width Inside Knuckle: 3/4"

Sold and priced as a pair (2-hinges)



** This item is discontinued.
